claims.claim: We use it to store water in our house and different places
claims.evidence: No photo evidence of usage history or water-only storage.
No label, certification mark, or manufacturer plate visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: Interior not shown; no way to confirm prior contents or number of uses.
Only exterior cage and tap are visible; no close-up of tank walls or seams.
Top of the IBC tote is not visible in the photo; lid status cannot be confirmed.

risks.risk: Unknown litre capacity of the IBC tote
risks.proof: A clear shot of the manufacturer's capacity plate or embossed markings on the tank body
risks.if_unproven: priced as the smallest common IBC size (often 1000L assumed but unverified)

risks.risk: Possible chemical or non-food prior use causing contamination
risks.proof: Close-up photos of interior through the lid opening, and any manufacturer/food-grade sticker

risks.risk: Valve/tap may be worn, cracked, or leaking under pressure
risks.proof: A video of water being run through the tap at full flow
risks.if_unproven: priced as faulty valve needing replacement

risks.risk: Cage and pallet base condition (rust, bent bars, cracked pallet)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all four cage corners and the pallet underside
risks.if_unproven: priced as cage/pallet in poor condition

risks.risk: Ambiguity over which tank in the yard is actually for sale
risks.proof: A photo with the seller pointing to or standing next to the specific unit, plus a close-up matching the listing
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lowest-value plausible unit in the yard

risks.proof: A top-down photo showing the lid fully closed and latched

proof_requests: Photo of the capacity plate/embossed litre marking on the tank
Top-down photo showing the lid closed and latched
Close-up photos of all four cage corners and pallet base
Interior photo through the open lid showing residue or staining
Short video of the tap running at full flow
A photo clearly identifying which specific tank in the yard is for sale
response.reason: The witness confirms it is an IBC tote tank, so it can be priced, but every seller claim about grade, history, and condition is unverifiable from the photo and must be priced at worst case until proof is supplied.
